maria_p: Heads-up — intermittent hang during shutdown in one of our FastAPI services. We reuse a single httpx.AsyncClient on app.state and sometimes uvicorn shutdown hangs or we see 'RuntimeError: Event loop is closed'.

maria_p: Minimal repro attached below, happens after a few concurrent background tasks have run.

maria_p: ```py
# app startup
async def startup():
    app.state.client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10.0)

# background task
async def bg_task():
    r = await app.state.client.get(url)
    return r.text

# shutdown
async def shutdown():
    await app.state.client.aclose()
```

alex: Ugh. I hit similar when tests create their own event loop (pytest-asyncio) and we reuse a global client. Might be a loop/transport lifecycle mismatch.

jamie: Does the hang correlate with calling aclose from a different loop than the one the client used? AsyncClient internal transport sockets are bound to the loop that created them.

maria_p: I think so. The background tasks run on the app loop, but our shutdown hook runs in a different thread in some deployments (gunicorn/uvloop interplay?). It's not deterministic.

sam_sdk: Quick Q: which httpx version? We saw fixes around shutdown handling in 0.23.x -> 0.24.x. Also if someone passes loop references or uses AsyncClient as a global, the contextvar state can be surprising.

maria_p: httpx==0.24.1 in prod. Reproduces locally with uvicorn[standard] and uvloop.

kyle: Could you try creating/closing client inside lifespan (per process) instead of module-level global? Lifespan is what FastAPI recommends: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/events/

maria_p: Tried that, still got one case where shutdown waited forever on a pending send. The stack showed httpx._transports.asyncio.AsyncioBackend.send blocking.

alex: Another workaround: use anyio.Event and cancel background tasks before closing client, or call client.close() synchronously via run_until_complete on same loop. Ugly.

jamie: Two product asks: 1) our Python SDK should expose an async context manager to manage client lifecycle (so users don't have to keep a module-global client). 2) docs/example showing safe reuse patterns with FastAPI/uvicorn/asyncio.

sam_sdk: Agreed on docs. Also add typing for AsyncClient in our SDK so mypy flags misuse (like storing client on sync objects).

maria_p: For immediate patch I added an AsyncExitStack in lifespan to ensure proper teardown and forced cancellation of background tasks before aclose. That reduced occurrences.

devex-bot: Note added to backlog: DEVEX-412 async client lifecycle example + SDK async context manager.

kyle: We should also add a small reproducible test in our examples repo that runs with uvloop & pytest-asyncio to catch regressions.

alex: FYI I can PR: add sample FastAPI lifespan example + explanation about event loop ownership, and a short section 'Common shutdown pitfalls' with code snippets.

maria_p: Thanks — I'll paste a failing trace and small repro into the PR comment.

jamie: Also consider a helper API on SDK: `create_async_client_for_lifespan()` that returns an AsyncClient wired to correct lifecycle and documented. Avoids people shooting themselves in the foot.

sam_sdk: I'll mock up types + contextmanager in the SDK: `class RedwoodClient: async def __aenter__...` and `__aexit__` with tests.

maria_p: Awesome. If anyone sees similar in other services, ping me. Posting the trace now...

maria_p: ```
RuntimeError: Event loop is closed
  File "site-packages/httpx/_transports/asyncio.py", line 315, in send
    await sock.send(...)
  File "asyncio/selector_events.py", line ..., in _sock_sendall
    raise RuntimeError('Event loop is closed')
```

alex: Thanks — this thread is gold. Small follow-ups: add CI job that runs the example with uvloop enabled + run shutdown sequence, and ensure SDK has clear guidance for FastAPI/uvicorn deployments. :thumbsup:
